root_cause.summary: The CLI sent the display ID (INC-31) to /v1/incidents/{id}, which accepts a UUID, slug or bare sequential number, so the lookup returned not found. PR #32 (v0.3.2) added api.NormalizeIncidentID and wired it into every incident-ID command. Master already contains the fix; this lane only adds assertions that pin it.

before.description: Reported on a pre-v0.3.2 CLI: incidents get INC-31 returned 'incident not found: INC-31'. Not reproducible on master, where the fix already exists.

after.description: On HEAD, INC-31/inc-31/31 request /v1/incidents/31 (TestNormalizeIncidentID, TestRunGetNormalizesSequentialID). A 404 reports 'failed to get incident INC-999: incident not found'.
